The three drafts that were left are settled: one shipped and two are dropped. There weren't six to take. The other lanes had already finished the rest of the list, so mine were the last three.

- **`evsh`: DROPPED.** The convoy start and the bounty step-out already skip strongholds in the current build (`shAt(x,y,80)`).
- **`shrespawn`: DROPPED.** Strongholds are now real map buildings with walls. The fence and the side the player was remembered on (`p.shS`) are gone, so the bug can't happen.
- **`shforge`: DONE, shipped as v29.09 via `cw-shforge`.** The old draft's anchor no longer exists, so I rebuilt it. A building holding the Forge, or within 70 of it, is no longer a stronghold candidate. The new check moves the Forge into a candidate building and fails if that building is still picked. Preflight passed. The ship gate passed with the seed 4242 fingerprint unchanged: ents 85/374, containers 165/593.

I didn't confirm the check fails on the old build. I relied on the preflight and gate passes. Per the draft's description, the Forge fell inside a compound in about 3 seeds in 100. I haven't tested whether any real seed puts the Forge in a stronghold building under the current layout, so this fix may be a guard rather than a cure.

Every row in `tools\handoff\console\notes\2p-drafts.md` is now DONE or DROPPED. I never created a `b-16-2p-drafts.md` notes file, since the shared table was the record.

TASK DONE
